items.title: Atari Homebrew Awards canceled over torrent of AI games: 'I saw no path forward'
items.excerpt: Organizer ZeroPage Homebrew suspended the ninth Atari Homebrew Awards after a flood of AI-assisted submissions - some developers releasing multiple games a week - made it impossible to set or verify a cutoff for AI use in music, art or code without witch hunts or false positives.

items.title: What's New for Game Developers: AI Animation and RTX Tools
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's Kimodo becomes the first AI motion-generation model integrated into Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview's guided animation framework, letting animators generate character motion in Sequencer from text prompts, spline paths and target poses; the In-Game Inferencing SDK 1.8 adds RTX Spark support, updated llama.cpp/whisper.cpp backends and Parakeet speech recognition.

items.title: The race to port GTA 6 to PC, explained
items.excerpt: PC Gamer explains why unofficial GTA 6 PC ports are arriving within days of the leaked Xbox executable: AI coding tools like Claude have drastically sped up static recompilation, producing buggier but fast, functional ports - and making it far harder for publishers to contain them.

items.title: GTA 6 recomp leaders bail out as Take-Two cracks down on illicit efforts to get the game running on PC
items.excerpt: After Take-Two's takedowns, the leads of Project Leonida - the best-known effort to use AI to quickly recompile the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 for PC - quit, though others continue; PC Gamer notes AI makes such ports far faster and tougher for publishers to stop.

items.title: 3D 몰라도 64방향 스프라이트 뚝딱 '미소 에디터' 출시
items.excerpt: Miso Editor, released in early access on Nov 23, lets 2D developers with no 3D experience auto-rig, animate and export up to 64-direction sprite sheets from a 3D model; its built-in MCP server lets AI agents handle rigging, weapon setup, animation and sprite rendering, and the itch.io edition adds API-based image-to-3D generation.

items.title: 디스코드, 게임 명장면 자동으로 저장하는 기능 도입
items.excerpt: Discord launched Auto Clips for Nitro subscribers on Windows: an on-device machine-learning model listens for laughter or shouting in voice chat and saves the last 60 seconds of gameplay, with game-event detection for League of Legends, Dota 2, CS2 and Rocket League and an opt-out for appearing in others' clips.

items.title: SOOP, 다시보기 장면 찾는 AI 검색 도입
items.excerpt: Game-streaming platform SOOP rolled out three in-house AI features - VOD scene search, AI summaries of a streamer's recent activity and AI VOD chapters - letting viewers search for and jump to specific moments inside videos, starting with select streamers.

items.title: AI 안경 부정행위...게임은 어디까지 금지할까
items.excerpt: After AI smart-glasses cheating concerns hit Korea's college entrance exam, Gamey compared FIDE, WSOP and Riot Games rules: all restrict devices and real-time decision assistance, with Riot explicitly barring overlays that feed live performance-changing information while allowing post-match review tools.

items.title: Shogi AI has grown so strong that computer shogi tournaments see 80% first-move win rates even with handicaps
items.excerpt: After the 7th World Shogi AI Denryu-sen finals, YaneuraOu developer Yaneurao warned that shogi AIs are now so strong the first player wins about 80% of games even with a time handicap, making 'first-move-wins' a near certainty and tournaments increasingly hard to run.

items.title: Unity Asset Store and CLI: Let Your AI Agent Find and Add Assets
items.excerpt: Unity connected the Asset Store to the Unity CLI so coding agents can search the store, pull single prefabs out of packs and generate missing assets with 60+ AI models directly from the command line.

items.title: Clash Royale recruits creator of AI cheating tool to help catch cheaters
items.excerpt: Supercell said the creator of an advanced AI cheating tool for Clash Royale was caught and has agreed to join the team building new anti-cheat technology, a day after warning that AI cheating would get players banished from the Arena.

items.title: AI Evaluates, Humans Decide: The Next Step in Game Rating Classification
items.excerpt: A Nexon-led industry-academic consortium presented first-year results and plans for AI-assisted game rating technology, in which AI pre-evaluates game content and human reviewers make the final classification decision.

items.title: Introducing Voice Isolator
items.excerpt: Inworld released Voice Isolator, two 48 kHz models (offline and realtime streaming) that strip background noise while keeping speech, laughter and breaths, with code and weights under Apache 2.0 - a separate release from its SAVA launch.

items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview 2 Brings Browser-Based Gaming To Blueprint-Only Projects, Enables AI Workflows By Default And Improves Rendering
items.excerpt: Epic's new UE 5.9 Preview 2 build turns on the default AI toolsets, adds Blueprint-only web game export with WebGPU improvements, and speeds up cinematic workflows - a new build, not a recap of the UE6 Blueprints announcement.

items.title: [AI & LAW] 지스타 간판 된 AI 게임…국내는 '설계' 심의, EU는 '결함' 묻는다
items.excerpt: With Wrtn's AI chatbot Crack as G-STAR's first non-game main sponsor, Korea's Game Rating and Administration Committee says AI chat alone is not a game but paid-currency probability mechanics can be; a new youth-protection bill would review 'relational AI services' by their design, while the EU moves to post-hoc liability.

items.title: Imitation Disputes Shift from 'Like Games' to 'AI Cloning'
items.excerpt: Korean legal experts say the focus of game imitation disputes is moving from genre/rule-copying 'like games' to AI cloning, where AI is used to replicate games in their entirety.
